remainingLimitations: Idle activation remains unsupported without a faithful future owning request; inactive W2 preparation remains available at eligible idle states.
Unknown cloud capacity returns unsupported compaction without fit certification; the existing provider inference path remains available.

Source/structural validation does not prove semantic completeness, and original W2 prose observations remain explicitly partial.
Active detached-child startup persistence can fail; such a child then defers or blocks parent compaction rather than acquiring invented recovery state.
Original evidence is reprocessed across repeated staged reductions; CPU/compaction overhead can grow with source size. No constant-cost long-run claim.
No arbitrary process-kill/power-loss recovery, exact cloud/GGUF tokenizer, real vision/model-quality, or live-account certification.
Five prohibited Git-mutating suites excluded; no fresh pre-edit full-suite identity baseline. Full W4 criterion 21 cannot be certified.
Broad suites retain failures, including an LSP indexing assertion that passed in isolation. W5/W6 readiness is not certified.
